messages.author: ec79ef2df02af517
messages.subject: Installing Shiny Server on Debian 7 (Wheezy)
parts:
Hello,

I've been attempting to install Shiny Server on my Debian 7 server, but have run into a few problems. Unfortunately reading the documentation didn't produce solutions, or perhaps my reading was not thorough enough. Please berate me if the latter is the case.

Initially I just tried to install the Ubuntu deb file. I found a webpage outlining the process someone had used successfully with Deb 6.

http://www.thecoatlessprofessor.com/programming/r/installing-the-open-source-shiny-server-on-dreamhost-vps-debian

Unfortunately, it seem like an older version of Shiny Server (1.0.0) as used in that post may work, but the newest package I downloaded (1.2.0) no longer does. The install seemed to go fine, but when launching shiny-server I receive the following errors:

/opt/shiny-server/ext/node/bin/shiny-server: /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.15' not found (required by /opt/shiny-server/ext/node/bin/shiny-server)
/opt/shiny-server/ext/node/bin/shiny-server: /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.14' not found (required by /opt/shiny-server/ext/node/bin/shiny-server)

Deb 7 only has GLIBC_2.13 equivalent. I could install a compatible lib.so.6 from the Experimental repositories, but am extremely reluctant to do so as this has the potential to break everything and reduce me to a snivelling wreck (or at least sigh, swear a lot and start to rebuild the entire server).

My first question is whether it would be possible, or even sensible, to install an old 1.0.0 deb package? Is the upgrade path to 1.2.0 straightforward from an existing installation?

I next tried to build from sources. After messing about with a newer version of cmake from wheezy-backports, I made good progress. However, during the make step I am stopped at the node configuration step with the following errors:

[ 11%] Built target shiny-server
[ 22%] Performing configure step for 'node'
/home/phillc/downloads/shiny-server/external/node/node-v0.10.21/configure
make[2]: *** [external/node/node-prefix/src/node-stamp/node-configure] Error 1
make[1]: *** [external/node/CMakeFiles/node.dir/all] Error 2
make: *** [all] Error 2

While I am comfortable enough building from source, I'm not knowledgeable enough to troubleshoot quite vague make errors such as the one above. I know it's a problem with node configuration, but I have no idea what that configuration error could be.

Any thoughts, hints and suggestions much appreciated.

Phill

messages.subject: Re: Installing Shiny Server on Debian 7 (Wheezy)

Hi,

I got shiny working under wheezy, but of course I had to update glibc from jessie and utilized the Ubuntu deb package. For step-by-step instructions (in german) see: http://mars.wiwi.hu-berlin.de/mediawiki/sk/index.php/Shiny .

Good luck Sigbert
